The '''unidentified desert moon''' was an unnamed world orbiting a gas planet, which was located near [[Aridus/Legends|Aridus]]. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] dueled a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Covenant Shadow|Shadow]] [[Celeste Morne]] in one of the ruins located on the moon.

==Geography==
===Landmass===
[[File:Desertmoon.jpg|thumb|left|180px|The barren surface of the moon]]
The surface of the moon lay barren except for intermediate low-lying vegetation. Shallow valleys carved through the ground and rocks jutted up from beneath the surface all along the terrain.<ref name="Dark Times 11" />

===Species===
Small, blue reptilian creatures with four limbs dwelt on the surface.<ref name="Dark Times 11" />

==History==
By [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the moon orbited its planet in such a way that the moon remained continually in the planet's shadow, creating a perpetual twilight upon the world's surface. Abandoned ruins remained standing on the surface as evidence of a previous civilization.<ref name="Randy Stradley">{{DHBoards|subdomain=www|url=Help/Boards/viewtopic.php?t=13792&start=30&sid=5d51d3736bb80962dc9038f01f684952|thread=DARK TIMES #12 -- A lose-lose-lose situation!|user=[[Randy Stradley]]|date=2008-06-28|time=10:46}}</ref>

Also at this time the moon acted as the site for a [[First duel on unidentified desert moon|duel]] between [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Shadow]] [[Celeste Morne]] and [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="Dark Times 11" /> The duel ended with Celeste harnessing the power of the [[Muur Talisman]], which she possessed and used to transform Vader's stormtroopers into [[rakghoul]]s. Vader then fled the planet, leaving Celeste stranded.<ref name="Dark Times 12" />
